label: outnumbers
definition: Group X has a larger number of members or counted units than group Y in an explicitly stated context.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit outnumber relation; a stated numerical comparison establishing a larger count; historical counts in a particular population. Excludes: electoral victory or political control without numerical comparison; generic superiority or strength; score or performance comparison not counting group members. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear counted population or ordered groups; a truncated comparison that omits what is counted. This concerns a stated population and time; it does not imply universal or permanent numerical superiority.

facts.reason: Democrats → Republicans: Direct outnumber evidence establishes numerical superiority in the stated group context.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
